correctness.rationale: The source trace representation and length formula are used exactly. For \(p>3\), scalar invariance of \(S\) forces every linear first moment and bilinear second moment to vanish, while \(|S|\equiv0\pmod p\); this makes the punctured affine-evaluation Gram form identically zero. For \(p=3\), every source codeword has weight divisible by \(3\), hence zero self-inner-product, and polarization yields pairwise orthogonality. The source dimension is \(7\). In the unpunctured code, the only remaining Gram contribution is \(\operatorname{Tr}(b)\operatorname{Tr}(b')\); surjectivity of the trace makes its radical exactly the codimension-one subspace \(\operatorname{Tr}(b)=0\). Independent replay at \(p=3,7\) verifies all finite-field premises, the punctured zero Gram matrix, the ternary enumerator, and the unpunctured rank-one Gram form.
